high_level_description: The image is a collage of two photographs showcasing a futuristic red sports car. The top photograph captures the exterior of the car in motion on a road with a mountainous landscape in the background. The car has a sleek, aerodynamic design with a low profile and large wheels. The driver is wearing sunglasses and a white helmet, adding to the high-tech and adventurous feel of the scene. The bottom photograph provides an interior view of the car, highlighting its modern and minimalist design.
